dedupe_keys.name: heapo heat pump households smart meter data and on site inspection protocols canton of zurich

description: HEAPO is an open dataset of electricity consumption from 1,408 households with heat pumps and smart electricity meters in the canton of Zurich, Switzerland, recorded at 15-minute and daily resolution between 3 November 2018 and 21 March 2024, released by ETH Zurich researchers with co-authors from the utility EKZ and the University of Bamberg. Besides the meter data it includes household metadata, weather data from eight stations, and ground truth from 410 field visit protocols written by energy consultants during heat pump optimisations, which record system set-up and faults; a Python data loader on GitHub helps process the data. The authors motivate it with inefficient heat pump operation caused by planning flaws, faults and misconfiguration. Coverage: Zurich canton households. Access: free Zenodo download (version 1, March 2025). Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the descriptor was a preprint under review when released and the authors say updates may follow; households are EKZ customers only. Simulation uses: heat pump load models, fault detection, demand-side flexibility and grid impact studies. Related records: the EKZ residential load profiles and the CKW smart meter data.
